glosses: A Romance language spoken in Cantabria.
The language of the Cantabri, formerly believed to be Basque but now generally thought to be Celtic.

examples.text: The ancient Cantabrian, in effect, is still found to subsist in the more barren and mountainous parts of the provinces of Biscay, Asturias, and Navarre.
